recommended_next_phase: 145G.3V -- Decision-Session Identity-Bound Resumption Independent Verification. This recommendation does not authorize 145G.3V, 145G.4, or 145H.
summary: Recovers Phase 145G.3's failed governed finalization: 145G.3's implementation completed successfully and was committed, but pcae phase complete was rejected by the Repository Transition Validator, leaving the canonical phase report (.pcae/phase-reports/latest.json) stamped 145G.2V. Independent reproduction confirmed the rejection (disagreeing phase-identity sources, cross-phase commit contamination citing four 145G.2V-named commits) was a correct, deterministic consequence of .pcae/phase-completion-metadata.json still holding Phase 145G.2V's own stale phase_id/phase_commits at the exact moment pcae phase complete was first run -- the hand-authored correction to phase_id: 145G.3 happened only in a later step of the same prior session, not before the failed attempt. Neither the identity-consistency check, the metadata-consistency check, nor the commit-contamination detector had any defect; each correctly reported genuinely stale input. A distinct, pre-existing tooling defect was found and disclosed, not repaired: complete_phase() (src/pcae/core/phase.py) releases the agent lock unconditionally before _finalize_report_and_notify() (where the transition validator actually runs) is ever called, so any rejected finalization attempt releases the lock regardless of outcome, forcing an unnecessary session bootstrap --sync-lock re-acquisition. Recovery: phase_commits in the metadata was completed to list all three of 145G.3's own commits, then pcae phase complete --stage-pending-report was re-run (not pcae phase-report create, whose own gate has no push-state special-casing and would only ever write a quarantine file, never promote latest.*). The transition validator now accepts the transition; the canonical report is staged PENDING PUSH -- explicitly non-authoritative, not notified -- at .pcae/phase-reports/latest.json/latest.md, correctly identifying 145G.3. This is the accurate state given three still-unpushed commits, not a workaround: a canonical report cannot legitimately claim complete trust status while unpushed, by this repository's own finalization design. Every authoritative identity source (metadata, canonical report, PROJECT_STATUS.md, pcae session bootstrap) now agrees. pcae push check reports Ready to push (Phase report identity: passed, Phase report trust: passed). No push was performed. See docs/PHASE_145G3R_CANONICAL_PHASE_REPORT_RECOVERY_AND_FINALIZATION_STATE_RECONCILIATION.md.
